user.title: HomeWizard 3-Phase Energy Disaggregator
user.description: Connect your HomeWizard Wi-Fi P1 meter 3-phase power sensors. The integration identifies large appliances (Boiler, Stove, Oven, Car Charger, Washer, Dryer, etc.) based on real-time power signatures and learns continuously with your confirmation.

data.phase_l1_sensor: Phase L1 Active Power Sensor (e.g. sensor.p1_meter_active_power_l1)
data.phase_l2_sensor: Phase L2 Active Power Sensor (e.g. sensor.p1_meter_active_power_l2)
data.phase_l3_sensor: Phase L3 Active Power Sensor (e.g. sensor.p1_meter_active_power_l3)
data.total_power_sensor: Total Active Power Sensor (Optional, auto-computed if empty)
data.notify_service: Notification Service for Learning (e.g. notify.notify or notify.mobile_app_phone)
data.auto_confirm_threshold: Auto-Confirm after N successful confirmations (0 = always ask)

init.title: Energy Disaggregator Options
init.description: Adjust detection sensitivity and notification preferences.
